title: Modular audio studio
summary: A playable patch with transport, three sequencers, two synths, a drum kit, effects, an 8-channel mixer, recording, key/MIDI bindings and the timeline.

steps.title: Start the sound
steps.text: Nothing plays until you press ▷ on mod.output; keep your volume low for the first run. The ⏺ button records the output to a WAV file, ■ is panic.
steps.hint: Queue never starts audio. ctrl+alt+space starts and stops it from anywhere, ctrl+alt+. is panic.

steps.title: Set the tempo
steps.text: Turn the bpm knob, or tap in your own tempo. Swing delays every second step. All three sequencers share this clock.
steps.hint: Double-click a knob to reset it. Hold Shift for fine control.

steps.title: Play the drums
steps.text: Click or drag cells to draw hits, Shift+click for an accent, Alt+click for a ghost note. Click a row name to mute it, right-click to remove it, + row adds one. Use 8–64 for the length and the note value for the step size.
steps.hint: The pattern stays a plain text string you can copy: kick:1000…;snare:…. ⚄ randomizes, ↺ ↻ rotate.

steps.title: Draw the bass
steps.text: The piano roll is a monophonic melody: click a cell to place a note, click it again for a rest, drag to draw a line. −12 −1 +1 +12 transpose, ⚄ writes a random phrase in the project scale, ♯ snaps drawing to it.
steps.hint: Wheel scrolls the pitch range. Alt-click or right-click makes a rest.

steps.title: Shape the bass synth
steps.text: Drag the envelope points for attack, decay + sustain and release. Drag the filter point sideways for cutoff and up for resonance; env sweeps the cutoff on every note. Choose the voice and waveform at the top, and play the keys at the bottom to audition.
steps.hint: The ⚙ button shows the plain parameter rows, which stay linkable to other nodes.

steps.title: Add the lead
steps.text: The lead is an FM voice with detune and vibrato, repeating through a delay. Try the ◿ saw wave or hp / bp filter modes.
steps.hint: Every panel control edits a real widget: link a CHOP or LFO to any of them.

steps.title: Mix and watch the meters
steps.text: Each strip has pan, a fader with a live meter, mute and solo. Press + for more channels (up to 8); the master fader is on the right.
steps.hint: Double-click a fader to return to unity.

steps.title: Bind keys and MIDI
steps.text: Press ⌨ on mod.output to open Bindings. This patch already has ctrl+alt+r (record), ctrl+alt+b / ctrl+alt+d (mute bass / drums) and, with a MIDI controller connected, CC74 on channel 1 for the bass cutoff. Choose any control, press ◉, then press a key or move a knob to learn it.
steps.hint: Workflow bindings are saved with the workflow; global ones (like ctrl+alt+space) stay in this browser.

steps.title: Float the timeline
steps.text: The timeline is a node: press Alt+W while hovering it to float it as an overlay window you can drag over the graph, or Alt+O to see only the timeline. Type a position or loop point in any format and tap a tempo.
steps.hint: Use it to automate parameters and record your knob moves.
